children: SYDNEY--WiseTech Global said cofounder and Chief Innovation Officer Richard White will face no action from Australia's securities regulator over an investigation into alleged share trading.
The logistics-software provider on Thursday said White and two other employees would face no enforcement action by the Australian Securities and Investments Commission.
WiseTech previously said it was cooperating with ASIC's investigation.
WiseTech said the regulator, known as ASIC, is still investigating another individual, who is not an employee.
WiseTech said ASIC had also decided to take no action over an earlier investigation into the company's governance, which began in 2024 amid a series of controversies related to White.
Regulatory attention has weighed heavily on WiseTech shares, which have lost more than 75% of their value over the past two years.
